literal: For those who wage war, a fortress is an asset; and for those who, fearing, protect themselves, it is also an asset.
translation: A fortress is an indispensable asset for those who take the offensive, as well as for those who, out of fear, seek only to protect themselves.
modern: போர் செய்யத் தொடங்குபவர்களுக்கும் அரண் ஒரு சிறந்த துணையாகும்; பகைவருக்கு அஞ்சித் தங்களைப் பாதுகாத்துக் கொள்ள நினைப்பவர்களுக்கும் அது ஒரு சிறந்த துணையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the universal importance of a fortress (அரண்) in warfare and defense. The author states that a fortress is a valuable asset (பொருள்) for two distinct groups of people. First, for those who actively wage war or take the offensive (ஆற்றுபவர்), it serves as a secure base of operations. Second, for those who are afraid of the enemy and seek only to guard themselves (அஞ்சித் தற்போற்றுபவர்), it provides a safe refuge. Thus, whether one is attacking or defending, a strong fort is an indispensable necessity.
